title: First Draft: 🦅 🇮🇷 Yep, Iran’s Definitely ‘Cartering’ Trump
author: Asawin Suebsaeng
content:
_On this day in 2020, Steve Bannon was arrested for defrauding donors to a
campaign to build a border wall. The top Trump ally ultimately pleaded guilty
to one count but served no prison time related to the case (though he did
serve time for contempt of Congress). He remains a prominent pro-Trump voice._

* * *

Welcome to Thursday. It's **Swin** , again. You may have heard by now that
"the MyPillow Guy" **Mike Lindell** - one of the [top financial
backers](https://www.thedailybeast.com/mypillow-ceo-mike-lindell-is-throwing-
down-big-money-to-fuel-pro-trump-election-challenges/) of efforts to overturn
**Joe Biden 's** 2020 election win - has refused to concede after he lost the
GOP gubernatorial primary in Minnesota, despite having **Donald Trump 's**
endorsement. In case you're wondering how it's going, on Wednesday afternoon
Lindell texted me a link to his **' Lindell Plan'** for privately funding a
recount, telling me: "**We need to get rid of the electronic voting machines
and secure our elections!** "

It would be easier to shrug this stuff off if it weren't also,
[essentially](https://zeteo.com/p/inside-dems-plans-to-fight-back-trump-ice-
polls), the animating policy position [of the White House and the entire GOP
today](https://zeteo.com/p/help-zeteo-defend-democracy-from). But enough about
the war on democracy at home…

In today's '**First Draft** ,' we'll check back in on the war abroad and how
it's going for the president of the United States (piss-poorly, for starters).
Plus, we consider another truly weird day in DC, filled with bizarro Trump
rants, amid worrying signs for the U.S. economy. Deep breath, and let's read
on.

In early May, we here at **' First Draft'** ran a story
[headlined](https://zeteo.com/p/is-iran-trying-to-jimmy-carter-donald): **" Is
Iran Trying to 'Jimmy Carter' Donald Trump?"** The answer was: **" Yeah,
probably."** Nearly four months later, the answer is starting to look a lot
like: **" Yes, absolutely."**

It's been half a year since the president launched his
[disastrous](https://zeteo.com/p/scoop-trumps-iran-war-has-burned),
[woefully](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-no-way-out) unpopular [illegal
war](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-doomed-from-start). There is [no end
in sight](https://zeteo.com/p/new-us-iran-strikes-show-trump-has), American
voters are [beyond fed up with it and its rising gas
prices](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-approval-falls-33-lowest-his-
presidency-reutersipsos-poll-finds-2026-08-17/), and the Trump-Vance
administration is still [flirting
with](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/01/politics/trump-iran-war-oil-prices-
strait-of-hormuz) global economic apocalypse simply because the ego-addled
president can't just admit he lost a battle that he laughably claims to have
**" won."**

In May, [we reported that U.S. government officials
had](https://zeteo.com/p/is-iran-trying-to-jimmy-carter-donald) **" privately
discussed classified intelligence assessments suggesting that the government
in Tehran isn't close to breaking, even after… months of war and a sustained
economic assault… Administration officials, citing U.S. intel, have also
warned that senior Iranian officials are keenly aware that if the war drags on
much longer, it could further damage Trump and the Republican Party's chances
at the polls in November. 'They know they can Carter him,' a senior
administration official familiar with the intelligence and internal
deliberations says, referring to how the Iranian hostage crisis [helped
tank](https://www.nytimes.com/2023/03/18/us/politics/jimmy-carter-october-
surprise-iran-hostages.html) Jimmy Carter's presidency by the time of the 1980
U.S. election."**

At the time, much of this intel had been briefed to Trump.
